description: Alligator River National Wildlife Refuge/ Albemarle-Pamlico Peninsula Climate Adaptation Project is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); The Nature Conservancy | Nags Head Woods; USFWS Eastern North Carolina Ecological Services. The Alligator River National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) is located in Dare and Hyde Counties, North Carolina, in the Albemarle-Pamlico Estuary. This climate change adaptation project is the result of a partnership between the North Carolina chapter of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and the U.S. Coverage: Manns Harbor, NC (2010). The toolkit gives Manns Harbor, NC as the location, 2010 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
